programme.title: El rostro impenetrable
programme.desc: Tras el atraco a un banco fronterizo, Johnny Río es traicionado por Dad, su mejor amigo. Apresado por la policía mexicana, pasa cinco amargos años en la prision de Sonora, durante los cuales, vive obsesionado con la idea de vengarse del traidor.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Escuela musical de primaria
programme.desc: Cuando la locura del canto y del baile llega a South Park, los chicos deben decidir unirse o renunciar a su popularidad.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El incastigable
programme.desc: Harto de cómo lo tratan sus padres, el siempre inocentón Butters se une a la nueva moda de los vampiros de forma un poquito demasiado entusiasta.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El anillo
programme.desc: Kenny se lleva a su nueva novia a un concierto de los Jonas Brothers donde reciben un anillo de pureza cada uno.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El mapache
programme.desc: De día es Eric Cartman, un alumno gordo de cuarto. De noche es 'El mapache', un justiciero gordo que lucha contra el crimen con un disfraz de mapache y desesperado por llamar la atención.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Villa Margarita
programme.desc: En una charla sobre la historia de Cristo, Randy implora a la ciudad que deje de perjudicar a la economía con compras impulsivas, pero un joven judío, Kyle, desafía esta práctica ortodoxa.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Come, reza y tírate chichipedos
programme.desc: Los hombres de South Park están disgustados por la nueva moda femenina de los 'chichipedos' y se unen para prohibirlos.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Pinewood Derby
programme.desc: Randy y Stan descubren sin darse cuenta la velocidad warp, lo que permite que la Tierra se una a la Federación Galáctica de planetas, pero un gánster alienígena amenaza con estropearlo todo.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Barbagorda
programme.desc: Cartman se entera de que los piratas saquearon todas las riquezas de Somalia, por lo que se pone un parche en el ojo y se lleva a un variopinto equipo a África para ponerse a la acción.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Famosos muertos
programme.desc: El fantasma de Michael Jackson se niega a aceptar su muerte, dejando al resto de famosos recién fallecidos en el purgatorio.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: F.C.L
programme.desc: Tras ver su primer combate de lucha libre de la WWE en directo, los chicos deciden formar su propia federación de lucha libre y que les sigan muchos paletos.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: La guerra de las ballenas
programme.desc: Kyle se une al equipo de un reality documental que se enfrenta a los balleneros japoneses, pero descubre que sus tácticas dejan mucho que desear.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: La palabra con M
programme.desc: Los chicos se enfrentan a un grupo de moteros desagradables, pero sus métodos obligan a la gente a redefinir el significado de una palabra bastante ofensiva.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Baila con los pitufos
programme.desc: La malicia de Cartman por fin es oída cuando lo eligen para ser el presentador matutino de la escuela y se aprovecha de su posición sin reparos.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Pis
programme.desc: Los altos niveles de pis en la piscina provocan un desastre que les estropea el día a los chicos, especialmente a Kyle. La xenofobia de Cartman vuelve a salir a la luz.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Curación sexual
programme.desc: Kyle and Butters se encuentran en medio de los famosos más conocidos de EE. UU. cuando se someten a un tratamiento por adicción al sexo. Cartman y Stan están pegados al nuevo juego de Tiger Woods.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: La Historia del escroto McBolas de Moco
programme.desc: Butters se lleva la culpa y la gloria después de que los chicos escribieran un libro que pretendía ser grosero pero que es aclamado como una obra maestra.
programme.sub-title: La Historia del escroto McBolas de Moco

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Pollo frito medicinal
programme.desc: Cartman se pone furioso cuando descubre que su restaurante favorito se ha convertido en un dispensario de marihuana medicinal. Randy está menos decepcionado.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Tienes 0 amigos
programme.desc: En contra de su juicio, Stan se hace Facebook y se convierte en un maestro de las redes sociales, lo que hace que la web le absorba.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Verano minusválido
programme.desc: En el campamento, con sus compañeros discapacitados, Jimmy no se da cuenta de los intentos de Nathan de matarlo. Los chicos organizan una intervención ya que a Toallín se le va de las manos lo de las drogas.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Pobre y estúpido
programme.desc: Cartman tiene una nueva ambición: quiere ser piloto de la NASCAR. ¿Podrá Cartman ganar la carrera de su vida?

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El origen
programme.desc: Mientras se encuentra en una sesión de terapia de grupo por almacenamiento compulsivo, Stan se queda atrapado en el sueño del consejero escolar, el Sr. Mackey.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Mapache 2: retrospectiva
programme.desc: El superhéroe vestido de mapache, El mapache, ha vuelto ¡y esta vez tiene amigos!

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Mysterion se subleva
programme.desc: Liderados por Mysterion, El mapache y sus amigos intentan ayudar a la gente en el golfo. Mientras, El mapache busca vengarse.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Mapache VS. Mapache y sus amigos
programme.desc: El mapache resulta ser incluso más malvado que el señor oscuro, Cthulhu, mientras se venga de sus antiguos socios.
programme.sub-title: Mapache VS. Mapache y sus amigos

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Crema Fraiche
programme.desc: Molesto por la obsesión perversa de Randy con los programas de cocina, Stan pide ayuda a Gordon Ramsey. Jamie Oliver es menos útil.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Chistobot
programme.desc: Después de ser objeto de burlas en los premios de comedia del colegio de South Park, Alemania construye la máquina de la risa definitiva: Chistobot. Sin embargo, sus planes para la raza humana no funcionan muy bien.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: T.A.P
programme.desc: Después de un vergonzoso incidente que involucraba las partes de un chico, Cartman tiene que ir a terapia para gestionar la ira y Randy hace todo lo posible para lidiar con las consecuencias.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Asociación atlética de bebés drogadictos
programme.desc: Cuando Kyle descubre que Cartman se ofrece como voluntario con bebés drogadictos en el hospital, sus sospechas aumentan. ¿Qué papel juega Slash (de Guns 'n Roses) en todo esto?

programme.title: South Park VOSE: City Sushi
programme.desc: Butters se ve envuelto en una guerra territorial asiática y sus padres descubren que tiene múltiples personalidades, así que deciden que la medicación es la única respuesta.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Anoburguesas
programme.desc: La crisis existencial de Stan continúa, mientras que Cartman se mete en el negocio de las hamburguesas con un ingrediente secreto superespecial.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El último de los mehicanos
programme.desc: Un juego de 'patrulla fronteriza' acaba mal y Butters termina reavivando el orgullo mexicano, pero Cartman no va a dejar que el juego se acabe ahí.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Indiscretos
programme.desc: El colegio de South Park es víctima de una página web de cotilleos y se lía pardísima. ¿Quién le pondrá solución? ¿Cartman o Gerbil King Lemmiwinks?

programme.title: South Park VOSE: 1 %
programme.desc: El 99 % está atacando a Eric Cartman.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Un día de Acción de Gracias del Canal Historia
programme.desc: Mientras que los chicos intentan aprenderlo todo sobre el Día de Acción de Gracias en el Canal Historia, se ven envueltos en un misterio que involucra a los extraterrestres, a Natalie Portman y al relleno del pavo.
programme.sub-title: Un día de Acción de Gracias del Canal Historia

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El niño pobre
programme.desc: A los padres de Kenny los arrestan y él acaba en un programa de acogida, haciendo que Cartman sea el nuevo niño más pobre del colegio. Mientras, una misteriosa figura enmascarada regresa del pasado.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Faithileo
programme.desc: El último meme en causar sensación en el pueblo es el 'faithileo', aunque se vuelve un poco desagradable después de un incidente que interrumpe un debate presidencial republicano.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: No debía haberme tirado por la tirolina
programme.desc: Los chicos están emocionados porque tienen por delante un peligroso día de tirolina en las montañas de Colorado, pero lo único que amenaza con matarlos es el aburrimiento.
programme.sub-title: No debía haberme tirado por la tirolina

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Sarcasmoball
programme.desc: Randy hace un comentario sarcástico acerca de que el fútbol es demasiado peligroso para los niños. La cosa acaba con un deporte nacional que involucra sujetadores y un globo.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Subiendo los niveles
programme.desc: Cartman admite por fin que está gordo y obtiene inmediatamente un scooter de movilidad.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Inseguridad
programme.desc: Cartman se instala un sistema de seguridad en casa.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Volviéndose nativo
programme.desc: Es hora de que Butters comience un viaje en el que seguirá el camino de sus antepasados hawaianos.

programme.title: Tormenta colosal
programme.desc: When a colossal tectonic shift causes the sea level to start rising, a microbiologist gathers the DNA of as many species as she can, while the military creates an "ark" in a desperate attempt to preserve life on Earth.

programme.title: Titanic II
programme.desc: On the 100th anniversary of the original voyage, a modern luxury liner christened "Titanic II," follows the path of its namesake. But when a tsunami hurls an ice berg into the new ship's path, the passengers and crew must fight to avoid a similar fate.

programme.title: La Cima
programme.desc: Después de que un hombre que intenta alcanzar finalmente su objetivo de escalar el Annapurna sufre un accidente, una escaladora que ha estado buscando refugio intenta ayudarlo.

programme.title: La aventura del Poseidón: Capítulo 1
programme.desc: El Poseidón es un enorme transatlántico de lujo que naufraga cuando unos terroristas hacen estallar unas bombas en pleno océano. El hundimiento sorprende a todos en plena nochevieja, y a partir de entonces los supervivientes intentarán ponerse a salvo.

programme.title: The unthinkable: The unthinkable
programme.desc: Suecia se enfrenta a un misterioso y desconocido ataque. No hay tanques ni ejércitos enemigos acechando, sino sistemas informáticos que se caen repentinamente e instalaciones o infraestructuras que explotan de repente.

programme.title: 10.000 días
programme.desc: Hace 10.000 días, un cometa impactó con la Tierra en pleno océano Pacífico con la fuerza de incontables bombas nucleares, sumiendo al planeta en nieve y hielo.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta
programme.desc: Dos actores de fenómenos televisivos (Juego de Tronos y Sex Education) protagonizan este fantástico romance. Un joven (Asa Butterfield) inventa una máquina del tiempo para recuperar a su exnovia (Sophie Turner).

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: ¡Alarma vuelo 502 secuestrado!
programme.desc: Un Boeing 707 hace un viaje rutinario entre Los Ángeles y Minneapolis. En pleno viaje, un veterano de la guerra de Vietnam, que parece enloquecido, secuestra el avión y obliga a desviar su trayectoria hacia Rusia.

programme.title: Batalla de Los Ángeles
programme.desc: En febrero de 1942, las fuerzas estadounidenses se enfrentaron a un OVNI sobre Los Ángeles. Hoy, después de casi 70 años, los invasores alienígenas han regresado.

programme.title: The Prosecutors: In Pursuit of Justice: Su orgullo y alegría
programme.desc: Orgullo y alegría se centra en Eric Napoletano, quien asesinó brutalmente a sus víctimas, incluida su esposa Myra.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: El 27 de abril de 2007, Gaëlle Fosset fue hallada muerta en su pequeña casa de Saint-Germain-la-Campagne, en Normandía.

programme.title: True Life Crime: ¿Trágico accidente o asesinato calculado?
programme.desc: Kenneka Jenkins, de 19 años, desapareció de una fiesta de cumpleaños en un hotel en los suburbios de Chicago una noche después de salir en vivo en Facebook. Casi 24 horas después, su cuerpo fue encontrado dentro de un congelador del sótano del hotel.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers ES
programme.desc: Al enfrentarse a un crimen, la única alternativa del investigador es hacer que las pistas hablen.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Presentado por Robert Stack, esta serie usa recreaciones y entrevistas para volver a narrar las circunstancias de los misterios que permanecen sin resolver. Cubriendo crímenes, historias de un amor perdido, historias inexplicadas y eventos paranormales.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Presentado por Robert Stack, esta serie usa recreaciones y entrevistas para volver a narrar las circunstancias de los misterios que permanecen sin resolver. Cubriendo crímenes, historias de un amor perdido, historias inexplicadas y eventos paranormales.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver: Episodio 3
programme.desc: Presentado por Robert Stack, esta serie usa recreaciones y entrevistas para volver a narrar las circunstancias de los misterios que permanecen sin resolver. Cubriendo crímenes, historias de un amor perdido, historias inexplicadas y eventos paranormales.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Caso Raphael Lomoro
programme.desc: Una joven denuncia la desaparición de su hermano Raphaël Lomoro, productor de vainilla de 46 años que vive en Madagascar.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Caso Émilie Godest
programme.desc: El 9 de noviembre de 2007, alrededor de las 23:30 horas, la ayuda llega al lugar de un accidente a la salida de Chatenay-en-France.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Un extraño robo mortal: el caso de Isabelle Mosser
programme.desc: Eric Mosser, un ingeniero de calefacción de 45 años, descubre a su esposa Isabelle tirada en un charco de sangre en su casa de Illfurth, Alsacia.
programme.sub-title: Un extraño robo mortal: el caso de Isabelle Mosser

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una luna de miel en crucero se convierte en una pesadilla cuando la novia es supuestamente lanzada desde un balcón en plena noche. Pero al llegar el informe meteorológico, que no muestra viento esa noche, comienza una investigación por asesinato.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Unas vacaciones sorpresa en crucero para una pareja de Olympia, Washington, termina con uno de ellos cayendo por la borda. ¿Fue venganza, celos o un impulso asesino en alta mar?

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: La asistente de un profesor desaparece en el mar cerca del final de un largo viaje. Las pistas sobre su desaparición se detallan en un diario encontrado en su cabina. ¿Cómo desapareció? ¿Alguien a bordo sabe qué le sucedió?

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: El protegido de la Parca
programme.desc: Christine, exesposa de Larry Mazza, no conoce el oscuro pasado de su marido cuando se casan. Protegido de un mafioso peligroso de Nueva York, Greg Scarpa, es un pasado difícil de escapar. ¿Podrán alejarse antes de que destruya sus vidas?

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: John Smith
programme.desc: Diane, tercera esposa de John Smith, no se cree las acusaciones contra su nuevo esposo. El FBI dice que mató a sus dos exmujeres. Diane y su hija Summer quieren saber la verdad. ¿Convencerán a Diane de que su marido es un asesino antes de que la mate?

programme.title: Homicidio en Hollywood: Dorothy Stratten
programme.desc: Cuando los cuerpos de la modelo de Playboy Dorothy Stratten y su esposo aparecen muertos en su casa de Los Ángeles, el detective de homicidios Richard DeAnda se ve envuelto en un oscuro caso de sicarios y pesos pesados de Hollywood.

programme.title: Homicidio en Hollywood: Tupac Shakur
programme.desc: Después del asesinato a tiros desde un coche en marcha del artista de hiphop Tupac Shakur, el detective de Las Vegas Wayne Petersen se adentra en las pandillas de Compton, donde descubre la cadena de acontecimientos que puso fin a la vida de Tupac Shakur.

programme.title: Homicidio en Hollywood: Phil Hartman
programme.desc: Cuando el querido comediante Phil Hartman y su esposa son hallados muertos a tiros en su cama, el detective de homicidios Tom Brascia debe reconstruir los trágicos hechos que llevaron al asesinato.

programme.title: El Incidente del Lago Falcon
programme.desc: Los extraterrestres visitan la Tierra a menudo; Destaca el incidente OVNI de 1967 en el lago Falcón de Canadá. Los frecuentes avistamientos de Canadá lo hacen enigmático.

programme.title: Base De Dulce: Los Nuevos Illuminati
programme.desc: Dulce, Nuevo México, es un punto de acceso para fenómenos misteriosos y una supuesta colaboración militar secreta entre humanos y extraterrestres.

programme.title: Linda Napolitano: La Abducción Alienígena del Siglo
programme.desc: La abducción alienígena de Linda Napolitano en 1989 es el caso de abducción del siglo.

programme.title: Archivos Gubernamentales de OVNIs Desclasificados
programme.desc: Los gobiernos guardan secretos. ¿Pero qué ocurre cuando estos secretos ya no pueden ser encubiertos más?

programme.title: Extraterrestres en la URSS
programme.desc: Misterios alienígenas sin resolver de la Unión Soviética: incidente del Paso Dyatlov, milagro de Petrozavodsk, caso Voronezh. Asombro y miedo, pero duda de la participación alienígena.

programme.title: Alienígenas: Los Encuentros Esotéricos
programme.desc: Las historias teosóficas de Madame Blavatsky, los relatos sobre demonios Jinn, y la vida de Maria Orsic narran dimensiones en las cuales, a través de la espiritualidad y el esoterismo, es posible establecer contacto con alienígenas

programme.title: OVNIs Nazis
programme.desc: Se rumorea que la Alemania Nazi desarrolló naves espaciales avanzadas y que científicos continuaron en bunkers en la Antártida y Sudamérica. Sin evidencia, la teoría mezcla esoterismo y restauración nazi paranormal.

programme.title: Extraterrestres Ancestrales: El Origen de la Humanidad
programme.desc: La creciente evidencia y los avistamientos de ovnis sugieren contacto con seres extraterrestres que pueden haber influido en los orígenes de la vida humana.

programme.title: OVNI: Primer Contacto
programme.desc: Nos adentramos en avistamientos de OVNIs y encuentros cercanos que involucran aeronaves comerciales y militares, trayéndoles los relatos más asombrosos de pilotos que han presenciado objetos voladores no identificados durante sus vuelos.

programme.title: Ingenieros Extraterrestres
programme.desc: Nuestra evolución puede estar influenciada por nuestros antepasados y sus dioses. No estamos solos en el universo.

programme.title: La Abducción de las Colinas: El Incidente Zeta Reticuli
programme.desc: Se explora el secuestro de Barney y Betty Hill y el incidente de Zeta reticuli.

programme.title: Cazadores De Ovnis: Los Ufólogos Italianos
programme.desc: Investigadores italianos exploran avistamientos masivos de ovnis, clipeología y testimonios reales, profundizando en la historia y los métodos de investigación de la ufología.

programme.title: Los Testigos: Encuentros con Antiguos Alienígenas
programme.desc: El contactado, el vidente y el abducido comparten experiencias similares y diferentes con seres de otras dimensiones, dejando una marca duradera de su presencia.

programme.title: Buddy Rich, Tom Warrington, Bob Kaye & John Marshall
programme.sub-title: Buddy Rich Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Buddy Rich, one of the most influential jazz drummers of all time, performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1978 with his orchestra. Rich's drumming was known for its remarkable speed and dexterity, which he achieved without any formal education.

programme.title: Paco de Lucía
programme.sub-title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía & Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival. However, the similarities between flamenco and blues have been well documented: both are the outlet for a poor, disenfranchised minority, with a primitive strength, boundless capabilities for improvisation and a requirement for breathtaking virtuosity - all qualities shown by Paco de Lucía in this performance. Moreover, he has long been experimenting with jazz forms (evident even from his inclusion of bass, drums, and saxophone in his sextet), while still retaining the essence of the flamenco tradition. In his own words: “What I have tried to do is have a hand holding onto tradition and the other scratching, digging in other places trying to find new things I can bring into flamenco”.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buck Clayton, Henry Chaix, Théo Siegrist & Pierre Bouru
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland. With a local rhythm section of French pianist Henry Chaix, Swiss double bassist Théo Siegrist, and Swiss drummer Pierre Bouru, this stalwart of the Count Basie Orchestra gave a sparkling performance that was documented for posterity by Radio Télévision Suisse in the program ‘Variétés'. Opening with the George Gershwin favorite ‘'S Wonderful', the program continues with two swing-era classics: ‘I Can't Get Started' and ‘Honeysuckle Rose'. Revel at how easily Clayton finishes ‘Honeysuckle Rose' on a high concert F! A spirited romp through Juan Tizol's composition ‘Perdido' closes this recording. The success of this booking ensured Clayton received repeated warm receptions in Bern in the following decades.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.sub-title: Herbie Man & Sonny Sharrock - Memphis underground
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Michel Legrand
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra. During this 1982 performance in the Belgian town of Spa, Legrand leads his orchestra through a number of original songs, including “The Summer Knows,” “What Are You Doing the Rest of Your Life?” and “Les Moulins de mon Cœur.” Singing either in English or French, Legrand delivers a spirited performance with plenty of romantic flair that is sure to capture your heart.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver's quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: “Adjustment”, “Barbara”, “In Pursuit of the 27th Man”, and “Song For My Father”. Tune in and let Horace Silver's irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Benny Goodman, Scott Hamilton, John Bunch & Phil Flanigan
programme.sub-title: Benny Goodman Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1982, legendary jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague with his septet. The “King of Swing” revisited the atmosphere of the 1930s, when jazz enjoyed tremendous popularity.

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He's a pirate/Davy Jones' from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest ‘Now We Are Free' from Gladiator ‘My Heart Will Go On' from Titanic and ‘Shallow' from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Rodolfo Mederos, Otros Aires, Teresa Parodi & Café de los Maestros
programme.desc: For the audience in the famous ballroom El Palacio in Buenos Aires, the year 2012 began with tango rhythms and Argentinean folk music. This festive broadcast opens with a tango performance by dance partners Eduardo and Gloria, accompanied by the renowned ensemble Café de los Maestros. Another highlights is a performance by bandoneon player Rodolfo Mederos and his trio. In addition, the concert features a performance by Teresa Parodi, former lead singer of the Astor Piazzolla Band, accompanied by the Fernando Suárez Paz Quintet. Also on the bill is the contemporary electronic tango formation Otros Aires. Founded by Miguel Di Genova in 2003, Otros Aires combines electronic rhythms and traditional tango instruments, such as the bandoneon, piano, and guitar. On the program are compositions by Astor Piazzolla, Pedro Maffia, Pedro Laurenz, Gustavo Mozzi, and many others. Enjoy this concert of music and dance, featuring some of Argentine's tango scene's finest artists!

programme.title: Glass Marcano, Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours & Stéphanie-Marie Degand
programme.sub-title: Beethoven Violin Concerto & Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris. In this concert, recorded at Opéra de Tours in February 2021, Marcano leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours in performances of two Romantic masterpieces. The program opens with Ludwig van Beethoven's Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61, featuring Stéphanie-Marie Degand as the soloist. This piece is one of the most important works in its genre. The program concludes with Georges Bizet's 1855 Symphony in C major, written when the composer was only 17 years old.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Daniel Harding, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino & Christiane Karg
programme.sub-title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart's swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart's sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Kiss
programme.desc: Kiss is one of the legendary groups in Hard Rock history. They have millions of fans around the world and over 100 million records sold. KISS confirms why they have been the best on the scene for nearly four decades, in a performance that made history, impressing an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than 2 hours and packed with hits, held at the Nurburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood
programme.sub-title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: John Denver
programme.sub-title: Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan
programme.desc: Arguably one of the most beloved American performers of the 20th century, John Denver had a career that saw him sell over 40 million albums worldwide while winning numerous awards, including 2 Grammy Awards, 3 AMA's, 1 Emmy and 2 CMA's. "Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan" is a 1981 concert from his 7-show tour of Japan and features a wonderful selection of hits from his career, including 4 of his 5 #1 hits: "Annie's Song", "Calypso", "Sunshine On My Shoulders" & "Thank God I'm A Country Boy".

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history. Based on the novel by the author of War Horse, Waiting for Anya follows the story of Jo Lalande, a thirteen-year-old shepherd living in the mountain village of Lescun. Though Europe may be ravaged by the horrors of World War II, Jo's world in the French Pyrenees has remained remarkably untouched. That is, until a ferocious encounter with a bear introduces Jo to the mysterious Benjamin, a Jewish refugee who is desperately awaiting the arrival of his missing daughter, Anya, before making his escape across the border. Making friends with Benjamin and his mother-in-law Horcada, an isolated widow who lives in the nearby mountains, Jo becomes aware of a very dangerous secret - the family are involved in smuggling Jewish children over the mountains to the safety of Spain. In a heroic act of defiance, Jo promises to assist Benjamin in his endeavours...but soon becomes embroiled in a perilous conspiracy when German troops make their descent upon the village. Filmed in the village of Lescun and the surrounding Aspe Valley, France in which the true to life story also originated, the film boasts an all-stellar cast including Noah Schnapp (Stranger Things), Academy Award Winner Anjelica Huston (Ever After, The Addams Family), Jean Reno (Leon, The Big Blue, Ronin), Frederick Schmidt (Mission: Impossible - Fallout), Thomas Kretschmann (The Pianist, Central Intelligence) and Nicholas Rowe (Riviera, Lock Stock and Two Smoking Barrels).

programme.title: To Be Someone
programme.desc: When an unhinged gangster coerces young nightclub owner, Danny, into completing an illegal drugs run to The Isle of Wight in return for his shares in the club, Danny's friends step in with an ingenious plan - they will all go to The Isle of Wight's annual Mod festival and use the thousands of Mod enthusiasts descending onto the island as a cover! A feel-good tale of modern-day mods, music, and scooter culture from the producer of The Krays and Love, Honor and Obey, starring the original cast of cult mods n' rockers film, Quadrophenia, including Leslie Ash (Men Behaving Badly), Mark Wingett (Snow White and the Huntsman), Toyah Willcox (Invasion Planet Earth), Trevor Laird (Doctor Who) and Gary Shail, alongside Sam Gittins (Await Further Instructions) and Perry Benson (This is England, Sid and Nancy).

programme.title: Gladiatress

Roman soldiers kidnap Dwyfuc, detaining her in Boulogne. Seduced by Roman society, she reveals locations of British ports crucial to the Romanss invasion strategy. Smirgut and Worthaboutapig set out on a perilous rescue mission together they must prevent the downfall of Celtic Britain, encountering gods, lawyers, soothsayers, barbarians and the Otherworld. Girl power is alive and kicking and ready to take on the Romans

programme.title: Deadly Target

Fuelled by rage and a burning need to avenge his brother, he sets out to hunt down the perpetrators and nothing is going to stand in his way... As he delves deeper to identify the murderers, he finds himself at the centre of a deadly conspiracy and a secret world of corruption one which cuts deep inside the U.S. Government, reaching the very highest levels of command. With a ruthless military assassin (Steve Austin, The Expendables) hot on his trail, Webster must expose the corrupt high-ranking officials before he becomes another victim to the very plot which killed his brother.

Welsh journalist Gareth Jones (James Norton: Little Women) risks his life to expose the truth about the devastating famine in the Soviet Union in the early 1930s. Also starring Vanessa Kirby (The Crown) and Golden Globe Nominee Peter Sarsgaard (The Batman). This is the most important true story you will ever see.

programme.title: Buddy Rich, Tom Warrington, Bob Kaye & John Marshall
programme.sub-title: Buddy Rich Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Buddy Rich, one of the most influential jazz drummers of all time, performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1978 with his orchestra. Rich's drumming was known for its remarkable speed and dexterity, which he achieved without any formal education.

programme.title: Paco de Lucía
programme.sub-title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía & Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival. However, the similarities between flamenco and blues have been well documented: both are the outlet for a poor, disenfranchised minority, with a primitive strength, boundless capabilities for improvisation and a requirement for breathtaking virtuosity - all qualities shown by Paco de Lucía in this performance. Moreover, he has long been experimenting with jazz forms (evident even from his inclusion of bass, drums, and saxophone in his sextet), while still retaining the essence of the flamenco tradition. In his own words: “What I have tried to do is have a hand holding onto tradition and the other scratching, digging in other places trying to find new things I can bring into flamenco”.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buck Clayton, Henry Chaix, Théo Siegrist & Pierre Bouru
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland. With a local rhythm section of French pianist Henry Chaix, Swiss double bassist Théo Siegrist, and Swiss drummer Pierre Bouru, this stalwart of the Count Basie Orchestra gave a sparkling performance that was documented for posterity by Radio Télévision Suisse in the program ‘Variétés'. Opening with the George Gershwin favorite ‘'S Wonderful', the program continues with two swing-era classics: ‘I Can't Get Started' and ‘Honeysuckle Rose'. Revel at how easily Clayton finishes ‘Honeysuckle Rose' on a high concert F! A spirited romp through Juan Tizol's composition ‘Perdido' closes this recording. The success of this booking ensured Clayton received repeated warm receptions in Bern in the following decades.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.sub-title: Herbie Man & Sonny Sharrock - Memphis underground
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Michel Legrand
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra. During this 1982 performance in the Belgian town of Spa, Legrand leads his orchestra through a number of original songs, including “The Summer Knows,” “What Are You Doing the Rest of Your Life?” and “Les Moulins de mon Cœur.” Singing either in English or French, Legrand delivers a spirited performance with plenty of romantic flair that is sure to capture your heart.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. programme.title: Horace Silver
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums. During this performance from July 20, 1976, Silver's quintet stretches out on four Silver originals: “Adjustment”, “Barbara”, “In Pursuit of the 27th Man”, and “Song For My Father”. Tune in and let Horace Silver's irresistible music mesmerize you!

programme.title: Benny Goodman, Scott Hamilton, John Bunch & Phil Flanigan
programme.sub-title: Benny Goodman Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1982, legendary jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague with his septet. The “King of Swing” revisited the atmosphere of the 1930s, when jazz enjoyed tremendous popularity.

programme.title: Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He's a pirate/Davy Jones' from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest ‘Now We Are Free' from Gladiator ‘My Heart Will Go On' from Titanic and ‘Shallow' from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Rodolfo Mederos, Otros Aires, Teresa Parodi & Café de los Maestros
programme.desc: For the audience in the famous ballroom El Palacio in Buenos Aires, the year 2012 began with tango rhythms and Argentinean folk music. This festive broadcast opens with a tango performance by dance partners Eduardo and Gloria, accompanied by the renowned ensemble Café de los Maestros. Another highlights is a performance by bandoneon player Rodolfo Mederos and his trio. In addition, the concert features a performance by Teresa Parodi, former lead singer of the Astor Piazzolla Band, accompanied by the Fernando Suárez Paz Quintet. Also on the bill is the contemporary electronic tango formation Otros Aires. Founded by Miguel Di Genova in 2003, Otros Aires combines electronic rhythms and traditional tango instruments, such as the bandoneon, piano, and guitar. On the program are compositions by Astor Piazzolla, Pedro Maffia, Pedro Laurenz, Gustavo Mozzi, and many others. Enjoy this concert of music and dance, featuring some of Argentine's tango scene's finest artists!

programme.title: Glass Marcano, Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours & Stéphanie-Marie Degand
programme.sub-title: Beethoven Violin Concerto & Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris. In this concert, recorded at Opéra de Tours in February 2021, Marcano leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours in performances of two Romantic masterpieces. The program opens with Ludwig van Beethoven's Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61, featuring Stéphanie-Marie Degand as the soloist. This piece is one of the most important works in its genre. The program concludes with Georges Bizet's 1855 Symphony in C major, written when the composer was only 17 years old.

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Daniel Harding, Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, Coro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino & Christiane Karg
programme.sub-title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart's swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart's sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Christian Zacharias, Orchestre National de Lille & Isabelle van Keulen
programme.sub-title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva' Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann's only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls. After, the composer's Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, is performed, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist. Written in 1853, it is Schumann's only violin concerto. The concert ends with a performance of Schumann's Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38, also known as the ‘Spring Symphony'. This optimistic work is written in 1841 and is the most performed of Schumann's four symphonies. This concert was recorded at Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Kiss
programme.desc: Kiss is one of the legendary groups in Hard Rock history. They have millions of fans around the world and over 100 million records sold. KISS confirms why they have been the best on the scene for nearly four decades, in a performance that made history, impressing an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than 2 hours and packed with hits, held at the Nurburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: Seal
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood
programme.sub-title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: John Denver
programme.sub-title: Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan
programme.desc: Arguably one of the most beloved American performers of the 20th century, John Denver had a career that saw him sell over 40 million albums worldwide while winning numerous awards, including 2 Grammy Awards, 3 AMA's, 1 Emmy and 2 CMA's. "Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan" is a 1981 concert from his 7-show tour of Japan and features a wonderful selection of hits from his career, including 4 of his 5 #1 hits: "Annie's Song", "Calypso", "Sunshine On My Shoulders" & "Thank God I'm A Country Boy".
